artifact_decision.analysis_source: The exact SHA-256-pinned Project Gutenberg UTF-8 electronic file, not a reconstructed or imputed print edition.
artifact_decision.permitted_claim: Version-conditioned lexical and MWE analysis after deterministic non-body removal and unit admission.
forbidden_claims: diplomatic representation of a named print edition
historical orthography evidence without comparison to page images
worldwide permission to bundle or serve source prose
representativeness of contemporary L2 or examination reading

review_policy.reviewed_material: Title, copyright, dedication, contents, illustration, explicit transcriber-note, and source-authored prefatory matter needed to locate the first retained prose unit and document the electronic artifact.
review_policy.excluded_from_units: Project Gutenberg notices and producer-added summaries, title/copyright matter, dedications, contents, illustration lists and captions, advertisements, and transcriber notes.
review_policy.first_unit_rule: After the enumerated exclusions, freeze the first retained source-authored prose section. A source-authored preface, introduction, or reader address is not skipped to reach a later chapter.
review_policy.front_matter_hash_rule: SHA-256 over the exact raw bytes of the inclusive one-based line range before the first retained prose section, preserving source line endings.
review_policy.textual_contributor_rule: A translator, adapter, editor, introducer, underlying source author, or other retained textual contributor must be named and rights-reviewed; purely visual contributors do not enter prose units.

boundary_location_exposure.reason: Locating first-unit boundaries and trailing transcriber notes exposed limited post-boundary text and isolated full-file pattern matches; this is disclosed even though no lexical or MWE decision was made.
boundary_location_exposure.selection_effect: None: the queue, exclusions, first-unit rule, and length gate were frozen before exposure; the adaptation hold follows contributor provenance, not topic or lexical content.
